summary.text: Enter the assets in Probate eService, then prepare, swear or affirm, and submit the supplementary affidavit.

steps.name: Enter the assets
steps.text: Log in to Probate eService using your Singpass. Follow the system prompt to key in the list of assets and submit it to the Court.

steps.name: Check the schedule
steps.text: The Schedule of Assets document will be generated automatically in Probate eService.

steps.name: Prepare the affidavit
steps.text: After the Schedule of Assets is approved, prepare the Schedule of Assets – Supplementary Affidavit.

steps.name: Swear or affirm it
steps.text: Swear or affirm the Supplementary Affidavit before a Commissioner for Oaths.

steps.name: Submit the document
steps.text: After this, log in to Probate eService and submit the document.
